name: Default
shortDescription: Open-source notification infrastructure with a workflow dashboard, REST API, Inbox websocket server and worker for email, SMS, push and chat.

alerts.message: Anyone who can reach the dashboard can create an account. Sign up first, then set DISABLE_USER_REGISTRATION to true and redeploy to block further sign-ups.

Delivery channels need your own provider credentials (SMTP or an email API, SMS, push) added in the dashboard. Triggers with email attachments fail until S3_BUCKET_NAME, S3_REGION, AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID and AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY point at a bucket. For an S3-compatible service other than Amazon S3, also set S3_LOCAL_STACK to its endpoint.
